channel.title: Detroit Sports Nation - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Detroit Sports Nation (detroitsportsnation.com)

item.title: NFL Championship Sunday Schedule: Times, Channels, and Matchups Revealed
item.description: The NFL’s final four are set for Championship Sunday as the Patriots face the Broncos in the AFC title game and the Rams travel to Seattle to take on the Seahawks for the NFC crown.

item.title: Did Alex Anzalone Just Reveal His Future With Detroit Lions?
item.description: Alex Anzalone’s cryptic social media reply has Lions fans wondering if contract talks are further along than expected as free agency approaches.

item.title: Buffalo Bills Make Decision on HC Sean McDermott
item.description: The Buffalo Bills are at a crossroads following their divisional round loss. A major organizational shift could reshape the franchise after years of sustained success.

item.title: Detroit Lions Next OC May Have Just Become Available
item.description: A major coaching change in Buffalo could open the door for the Detroit Lions to interview one of the NFL’s most respected offensive minds as their next offensive coordinator.

item.title: Detroit Lions Assistant Named to Senior Bowl Coaching Staff
item.description: Detroit Lions offensive assistant Marques Tuiasosopo has been selected to coach quarterbacks for the American Team at the 2026 Senior Bowl, highlighting Detroit’s growing coaching reputation.

item.title: Detroit Lions Stun NFL World With Unexpected Offensive Coordinator Hire
item.description: The Detroit Lions are finalizing a deal to hire former Cardinals offensive coordinator Drew Petzing. The move came with no prior rumors, continuing Dan Campbell’s trend of quiet, unexpected coaching hires.

item.title: Detroit Lions DC Kelvin Sheppard Learns Fate With Miami Dolphins
item.description: Detroit Lions defensive coordinator Kelvin Sheppard was passed over for the Miami Dolphins head coaching job, which went to former Packers DC Jeff Hafley, according to Adam Schefter.

item.title: Report: Dan Campbell Liked Mike McDaniel A Lot, But…
item.description: New report reveals Dan Campbell liked Mike McDaniel, but the Detroit Lions never viewed him as the right fit for their offensive coordinator role during their OC search.

item.title: Report: Dan Campbell Decides Who Will Call Plays in 2026
item.description: Detroit Lions head coach Dan Campbell has decided who will call offensive plays in 2026 after hiring former Cardinals OC Drew Petzing. Here’s what ESPN is reporting.

item.title: Detroit Lions Had Two ‘Unreported’ OC Interviews Before Hiring Drew Petzing
item.description: The Detroit Lions quietly interviewed David Shaw and Browns OC Tommy Rees before ultimately hiring Drew Petzing as their new offensive coordinator for 2026.
